description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests for Git commands, specifically focusing on the handling of the current working directory during various operations such as checkout, reset, merge, cherry-pick, rebase, revert, rm, apply, stash, and submodule removal. It sets up different repository states and verifies behavior when the working directory becomes or needs to be removed.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A macro or function used to define an expected successful test case.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after the test.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a directory.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Executes a command and verifies its output or behavior.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails as expected.
